'''Particle-emitters''' were technology that interfered with communications. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] called for the use of particle-emitters to foul communications in his [[Ackbar Refinement|Refinement]] to the [[Kenobi Offensive]].
